# Which lease offer is really the cheapest?

> Free commercial lease comparison calculator. Compare up to three offers on net effective rent and all-in cost per square foot after free rent, TI allowance, escalations, NNN costs and fit-out. See the cost of leaving early and the rent needed to match the best offer. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
